author: Cynthia Kaminski
text: Brian’s Septic Service did an outstanding job installing our new septic system. Clear quote, excellent communication, smooth installation, and they even handled the inspection process seamlessly. Professional, efficient, and trustworthy from start to finish—highly recommend.

author: Stephanie Robertson
text: Brian and another very nice man (i didnt catch his name) came today and did a pretty extensive repair and fixed issues we had where a company 3 weeks ago  didnt properly assess issue. Hopefully now everything is good amd going with the install of 3 d boxes. He was very explanatory about what he found and what he was doing as he did it. Hopefully ill not need anymore septic services but if I do it will be him and ill refer him every chance I get.

author: Kirby Graves
text: Brian’s septic saved our lives! We called them to replace our septic system after we had some back ups. We had family coming into town so we needed to do something quickly. After calling many people who wouldn’t call us back Brian and his team got out to our property to look at the job the next day, gave us a quote and even suggested an upgraded system that we ultimately chose to go with. He had a great rapport with the county inspector which gave me a lot of confidence in his work. It took them only 2 days to complete the job and they even got us connected early so we could take a shower.  I will always suggest to my friend’s family and clients that they work with Brian’s septic because we couldn’t be happier with their work. If I could give more than 5 stars I would.

author: Susie Hill
text:
He was on time, did a wonderful job, and was wonderful to work with. He answered all the questions I had and helped me to understand all that I didn't. He was thorough with explaining what he had to fix and why.
I would highly recommend this company to anyone having any plumbing issues.

author: Josh Bryant
text: Had a septic issue where I could not use any water in the house. Brian was the only septic service to answer the phone on a Saturday and came right out to help. Him and his helper got me back up and running in no time and let me know of another couple of issues that need to be addressed. Pricing is fair and honest. Would highly recommend Brian’s Septic Service.
